intent.instructions: What is the person who typed `keyword` most likely trying to do? Judge only the words of the keyword.

criteria.learn: Wants to understand a topic or solve a problem, not yet looking at products. Example: how to fix low ROAS.
criteria.compare: Weighing options, alternatives, reviews or best-of lists. Example: best smart ring 2026, oura vs whoop.
criteria.buy: Ready to purchase or get a price, trial, quote or demo. Example: buy running shoes size 11, hubspot pricing.
criteria.go_somewhere: Looking for one specific site, brand, company, login or location. A brand or company name on its own belongs here. Example: facebook ads manager login, nike.
criteria.unclear: Too short, ambiguous or mixed to call. Use this instead of guessing.

format.instructions: Which content format would best answer `keyword` for a searcher?

criteria.listicle: Ranked or grouped list of options.
criteria.comparison: Two or more named options side by side.
criteria.news: A dated news update or announcement; the keyword names an event, release or month.
criteria.product_page: A product, pricing or category page, not an article.
criteria.none_fit: No content format fits, for example a login or navigation query.
